title: dendrobium teretifolium var. fairfaxii
intro: Dendrobium teretifolium var. fairfaxii, commonly known as the Fairfax Dendrobium, is a variety of orchid native to Australia. The plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include improving respiratory function and boosting the immune system. Its therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off bacterial and viral infections, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the Fairfax Dendrobium include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
